title: ID0422069-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P7 170000667]-Charger in failsafe mode
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Charger in failsafe mode.
Solution:
Remove the 10.20.17.14 from the blocked IPs in the Router2
